title: SURE memory entry meta
description: sure/memory/meta/<target_skill>/<slug>.json (memory design spec 6.3): status and counters of one entry. Written only by python (publish / promote / cli) under the memory lock; counters are replayed from usage/<run_id>.jsonl, never incremented in place. Documentation only.
description_required: Only the state fields are required. component / cause / trigger / hook_trigger / scope / op / target_entry / similar_entry / orphan / derived_from / fix_exercised / evidence_sha256 come from the candidate publish.py wrote and are absent on metas reconstructed for entries that only ever lived in references (promote.legacy_meta, cli._meta_stub); the index parses those off the entry file itself.

hook_trigger.description: triggers used for hook injection: bad_case = the candidate triggers found verbatim (trigger_hits) in the run digest's repairs / log tail at publish; fact = trigger

target_entry.description: entry_id the modify / supersede candidate targeted

similar_entry.description: closest existing entry reported by the dedup rule, if any

orphan.description: true when the modify / supersede target no longer exists

entry_sha256.description: sha256 of the provisional entry.md text; refreshed by every rewrite; the indexer drops provisional entries whose file no longer matches

created.description: {run_id, date}; the string 'legacy' for entries that predate the memory system
